name: Aika
source:
Aika is a tough shell to crack. She hides her feelings and insecurities by making excuses related to her status as class president or politician's daughter. She just needs someone to help her loosen up a bit.

[From [url=http://www.saintxtail.com/#!new-page/c1jn]official site[/url]]
